scope: SELECTED intended choreography after root/Jev adoption. Documentation only; implementation remains halted.
rules: Logical prerequisite event is distinct from physical subscription trigger, original admission locator and required stage/terminal proof.

Keep existing 65 reactor registrations and 28 ProcessDefinition implementations as physical baseline; one Artifact Requested starter and one ArtifactDownloadProcess definition are selected future additions.
A pointer, process record, step order or count never substitutes for independently verified actual typed authority and complete immutable proof sets.
Preserve exact current public authorization, command term binding before early replay, OCC, original result, unknown outcome, cancellation and source-use/fence invariants.
Freeze occupied receiver identities and target selectors; new algorithms require explicit versioned/injective encoding and compatibility/fencing.

logicalEdges.actualSourceBinding: All four stage commands retain record.Source = ProfessionalDutyChangeAccepted. Claim is a logical prerequisite of apply; the receiver verifies the permanent claim. Recording alone acquires/settles the exact active-staff use; revocation skips those stages.
logicalEdges.intendedProofGate: Signature verified at source admission; permanent exact subject/duty/scope/digest claim. For recording, require exact granted active canonical staff proof bound to this change and held through FirmProfessionalDutyDesignationRecorded. Revocation does not require active staff. A local rejection fence forbids delayed apply; signed validity uses the frozen declared decision instant.
logicalEdges.commandIdRule: UUIDv5(source eventId, length-prefixed effectKind + canonical target stream + source lifecycle episode); external process callback source is the immutable accepted business source event plus exact effect key, never attemptId.
logicalEdges.principal: trusted reactor/process principal scoped to verified source tenant and concrete command kind
logicalEdges.recoveryContract: Exact replay returns original result; proven superseded operation is terminal no-op; unavailable dependency/unknown append is transient; changed intent or invalid proof is permanent conflict/quarantine.

currentSourceBindingEvidence.LocationNameChangeProcess: Claim consumes exact accepted-change proof; apply consumes the produced LocationNameClaimed proof; release consumes exact revision/cancellation proof, preserving the matching claim generation.
currentSourceBindingEvidence.OperationalProcessNameChangeProcess: Claim consumes exact accepted-change proof; apply consumes the produced OperationalProcessNameClaimed proof; release consumes exact revision/cancellation proof, preserving matching generation.

currentSourceBindingEvidence.ReadinessRunProcess: Compute uses ReadinessAssessmentRequested; adopt consumes the actual produced ReadinessAssessmentRecorded source plus the original request proof and exact pending adoption generation.
currentSourceBindingEvidence.IdentityRecoveryProcess: Claimed email challenge is the single registered root. Preparation consumes claimed proof; protect/accept consume actual IdentityRecoveryPrepared proof; register/revoke/complete consume IdentityRecoveryAccepted plus exact replacement/protection/revocation proofs; settlement consumes completed/rejected proof; original email completion and notice consume completed recovery.
currentSourceBindingEvidence.AdministratorTransitionProcess: One of three guard-root facts starts the process. Its frozen TransitionKind selects one typed apply receiver. The completion stage consumes the actual member/assignment apply proof; neutral transitions have no completion. Complete-marker classes are not stream subscribers.
currentSourceBindingEvidence.TypeIIRangeProcess: Opening/amendment acceptance starts the process. Acquire uses that root; Apply uses the produced calendar authorization fact. Settle uses the actual period applied/rejected fact. Separate release reactor consumes close/cancellation/opening-rejection sources, preserving exact period/generation/ranges.
currentSourceBindingEvidence.ControlOccurrenceFanOut: Exact DueControlOccurrencesGenerated source and complete frozen occurrence selection drive independent native child materialization.
currentSourceBindingEvidence.IndependentChildMaterialization: One parent admission root selects exactly its registered IChildMaterializationReceiver. The process name is IndependentChildMaterialization; the physical definition class is IndependentChildMaterializationProcess. No cross-child order or live-source requalification after irreversible historical admission.
currentSourceBindingEvidence.EmailChallengeDeliveryProcess: EmailAddress issued facts start one process. Purpose selects verification or recovery delivery receiver. The typed target stream belongs to IEmailChallengeDeliveryLedger technical KV state, not an aggregate/domain fact. Attempts reconcile unknown outcomes before resend within the selected budget.
currentSourceBindingEvidence.TenantInvitationDeliveryProcess: TenantMemberInvited starts technical delivery. Send persists attempt/result around the external effect; exactly one Sent/Failed receiver is selected by stored result, with stale attempts terminal. No delivery-attempt business event is invented.
